name: Underwear
definition: Garments worn next to the skin under other clothing, such as briefs, boxers, bras and vests.
notes: Jockey page lists briefs, boxers, trunks, thongs and jock straps as underwear styles

name: Thermal base layer
definition: Close-fitting garment worn next to the skin for warmth.
notes: Smartwool sells merino base layer tops and bottoms by weight, midweight 250g/m2

name: Corset (foundation garment)
definition: Shaping garment worn under clothing to mould the figure.
notes: Steel-boned underbust corsets sold for waist training, also fashion wear; Corsets Island lists overbust and waspie

name: Socks
definition: Knitted covering for the foot and ankle or lower leg.
notes: REI lists 438 wool socks by height and cushion level

name: Tights
definition: Close-fitting knitted covering for the feet, legs and hips in one piece.
notes: Tight Spot sells women tights and pantyhose by denier, sheer to opaque

name: Leg warmers
definition: Tubes of knitted fabric worn over the lower leg without a foot.
notes: ToeSox sells knee-high and thigh-high leg warmers

name: Gaiters
definition: Covering for the lower leg and ankle worn over trousers or boots.
notes: REI and Kahtoola sell hiking and trail running gaiters, low to tall

name: Period underwear
definition: Underwear made with absorbent layers for use during menstruation.
notes: Thinx and Modibodi sell washable underwear with absorbent gusset for periods; Modibodi also leak-proof swimwear

name: Stockings
definition: Close-fitting knitted covering for the foot and leg, held up by a garter or a band.
notes: Thigh-high stay-ups made to pair with a garter belt, 10 denier, nylon blend

name: Pyjamas
definition: Two-piece sleep garment of a top and trousers.
notes: PyjamasUK sells pyjama sets of top with shorts or trousers

name: Nightdress
definition: One-piece loose sleep garment of dress form.
notes: PyjamasUK lists nightdresses (24) and nightshirts (6) as separate women categories

name: Bathrobe
definition: Absorbent or soft robe worn before or after bathing or at home.
notes: Terry, waffle and velour bathrobes; shop says bathrobe and dressing gown are the same garment in the UK

name: Wearable baby sleeping bag
definition: Sleeveless or sleeved sleep sack worn by a baby in place of blankets.
notes: Grobag sleeping bags in tog ratings, sizes 0-6, 6-18, 18-36 months, worn by the baby

name: Swimsuit
definition: One-piece garment for swimming and bathing.
notes: Calzedonia sells one-piece swimsuits, 17 items, wired and wireless

name: Bikini
definition: Two-piece swimwear of a top and a brief.
notes: H&M sells bikini sets of separate tops and bottoms

name: Swim trunks
definition: Shorts or briefs for swimming, worn by men and boys.
notes: Onia sells quick-dry men swim trunks in 4 to 7 inch inseams

name: Beach cover-up
definition: Loose garment worn over swimwear at the beach or pool.
notes: Seafolly sells kaftans and cover ups worn over swimwear

name: Motorcycle helmet
definition: Helmet made for motorcycle riders.
notes: SHARP lists 67 motorcycle helmet brands with full face and system (flip-up) types

name: Cycling helmet
definition: Helmet made for riders of bicycles.
notes: Virginia Tech rates 311 bicycle helmets in road, urban, all mountain, multi-sport, full-face and e-bike types

name: Hard hat
definition: Rigid helmet made to protect the head at work from falling objects and impact.
notes: Discount Safety Gear sells MSA V-Gard hard hats, cap style and full brim, ANSI Type I and II

name: Welding helmet
definition: Helmet with a darkening visor made to protect the face and eyes of a welder.
notes: Airgas lists auto-darkening welding helmets by Miller, Lincoln Electric, ESAB, 3M Speedglas

name: Bee veil
definition: Mesh veil worn over the head and face by beekeepers.
notes: Dadant sells beekeeping veils: hood, square and round hat veils

name: Cap
definition: Brimmed or peaked head covering fitted to the head, without a full brim.
notes: END page names New Era caps; only the intro excerpt came back, no product list

name: Beanie
definition: Close-fitting knitted head covering with no brim.
notes: Carhartt sells knit beanies, cuffed and uncuffed; page also calls them acrylic watch caps

name: Safety glasses
definition: Eyewear made to protect the eyes from a hazard.
notes: Pyramex PMXSPEC, Intruder, Ztek safety glasses with ANSI Z87.1 impact rating

name: Ear defenders
definition: Ear muffs made to reduce noise reaching the ears.
notes: 3M Peltor over-the-head, behind-the-head and cap-mount earmuffs; Pyramex electronic earmuffs

name: Respirator
definition: Face-worn device made to filter or supply air against dust, fumes or gas.
notes: 3M 6000 Series reusable half-facepiece respirator with P100 filters, NIOSH

name: Face mask (medical or surgical)
definition: Mask worn over the nose and mouth for medical or surgical protection.
notes: iMask and Aurelia ASTM Level 3 earloop surgical masks sold in boxes of 50
